title: Reflexive sortedness for short lists
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$ be a memory function, and let $L$ be an integer list of length at most one. If $\mu$ stores $L$ starting at address $a$, then $L$ is sorted at $a$ below $fr$ relative to $\mu$: a permutation of $L$ is stored there in nondecreasing order, and $\mu$ agrees with itself below $fr$ outside the interval starting at $a$ of length $|L|$.
